supersedes: Do not use the earlier 88.59% / 328.083M nine-destination subtotal as a final Evernorth custody reconciliation; the updated ten-destination analysis and capital ledger show that grouping was incomplete.

capital_reconciliation.interpretation: The SEC 8-K separately discloses 600,000 XRP received from advance-funding subscribers. The cited October 22/23 ten-destination mapping accounts for the other 472,676,430 XRP but does not separately identify where that 600,000 XRP sits.

claims.claim: Evernorth's October 9 2026 closing Form 8-K says the business combination closed October 9.
Advance Funding Subscribers provided approximately $214.05M cash and 600,000 XRP tokens at closing; the 600,000 XRP is separate from the 84,365,876 XRP purchased by the custodian with cash.
Delayed Funding Subscribers provided $10.5M cash and 200,000 XRP at closing.
Arrington sponsor received equity for 211,319,096.061435 XRP; a Ripple-affiliated Larsen Lam trust contributed 50,000,000 XRP; Ripple contributed 126,791,458 XRP.
The six disclosed XRP components total 473,276,430.061435 XRP, consistent with the company's approximate 473,276,430 closing disclosure.

Q-Eternal reports 16 payments across ledgers 107832376–107832379 on October 22 from nine BitGo-activated source accounts to ten BitGo-activated destination accounts; all 19 accounts reportedly use 2-of-3 multisig.
limitations: Independent researcher, not Evernorth or BitGo; every transaction was not independently replayed in this run.

claims.claim: Q-Eternal's ten-destination allocation matches 211.319M sponsor XRP across four wallets, 126.791M Ripple XRP across three, 50M affiliate XRP in one, 84.365876M purchased XRP in one and 200K delayed-funding XRP in one.
limitations: The separately disclosed 600,000 advance-funding subscriber XRP is not separately located in this ten-destination table.

claims.claim: Bithomp pages opened for seven of the ten Q-Eternal destination accounts show activation by the same BitGo parent and account control marked multisig.
limitations: Three destinations were not independently opened in this run; signer identities and beneficial ownership were not inferred.

claims.claim: Q-Eternal reports a 5,223,608.29 XRP payment on October 23 to the BitGo multisig wallet matched to the 84.365876M purchased tranche, from BitGo-activated account rUWUJ2F3aZknSd8PVutoMnxowMK792maTD with destination tag 2.
limitations: Sender shows many tagged client-style transactions; tag 2 is not publicly mapped to Evernorth; no filing confirms an additional treasury purchase.

claims.claim: The October 22 ten-destination movement is more consistent with internal custody reorganization than a market sale because destinations are BitGo-activated multisig accounts and balances align with disclosed contributor tranches.
limitations: Legal beneficial ownership and custody mandates remain unconfirmed for every address; other time windows are not excluded.

claims.claim: The precise destination(s) holding the 600,000 XRP contributed by Advance Funding Subscribers are not identified in the ten-destination mapping.
Whether the 5.223608M XRP inbound transfer represents an Evernorth purchase, a client-tagged custody transfer, a reallocation or another customer deposit is not established.

hypotheses.statement: The October 22 movements represent an internal BitGo custody reorganization of Evernorth-related holdings, not a market sale.
support: 16 payments from 9 BitGo-activated 2-of-3 source accounts to 10 BitGo-activated 2-of-3 destination accounts.
Destination balances align closely with disclosed contribution tranches.
limits: Beneficial ownership and custody mandates for every address are not publicly confirmed.
The 600K subscriber tranche is not mapped.
Only the stated transaction window was analyzed.

hypotheses.statement: The 5.223608M XRP inbound payment is additional Evernorth treasury buying.
support: It reached a BitGo multisig wallet matched to the cash-purchased tranche.
limits: Sending wallet has many tagged client-style transactions consistent with omnibus processing.
No SEC filing or company statement confirms a treasury increase.
Destination tag 2 is not publicly mapped to Evernorth.

hypotheses.statement: The 600K advance-funding subscriber XRP is included within one of the ten mapped destinations.
support: The mapped group uses BitGo-related multisig infrastructure.
limits: The five mapped bucket balances sum to 472,676,430, exactly 600,000 below the SEC total.
No destination-specific ledger evidence identifies the 600K.

hypotheses.statement: The 370.346M gross outbound figure from XRP Insights represents a sale/disposition.
limits: The October 22 movement traced by Q-Eternal is internal among BitGo-activated multisig accounts and aligns with contributor tranches.
Gross outflow is not net disposition; intermediate custody hops can be counted.

prediction.reason: Custody attribution and the 5.223608M inbound transfer remain unresolved; this is not a predictive price signal.
